model.PREPARED: Policy is staged for a higher class, but certified evidence has not caught up; runtime caps to certified authority.
model.CERTIFIED: Evidence supports the prepared class and runtime may use that class ceiling.
model.CANARY_CERTIFIED: Alias of CERTIFIED for the one-user governed authority floor.
model.CANARY_EXPANSION: A transitional bridge from certified CANARY to prepared SMALL_BATCH that permits only the next blast-radius step with explicit bridge evidence.
model.PROVISIONAL_SMALL_BATCH: A transitional bridge that allows the first bounded 2-user cohort without certifying SMALL_BATCH.
model.SMALL_BATCH_CERTIFIED: Alias of CERTIFIED for completed SMALL_BATCH evidence.
model.PROMOTED: A certified class has been explicitly promoted after required outcomes, rollback, verification, and closure evidence.
model.DEMOTED: Runtime authority is intentionally below available certification because risk or operator policy reduced scope.
model.FROZEN: Runtime authority is temporarily zero because truth, evidence, snapshot, trust, prediction, or governance state is unknown.
model.REVOKED: Runtime authority is zero until a fresh operator governance program reinstates it.

CERTIFIED.next_state: PROMOTED only after explicit operator governance

PROVISIONAL_SMALL_BATCH.next_state: SMALL_BATCH_CERTIFIED after successful evidence or DEMOTED/FROZEN on failure
